item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbyings phyug shwa na ma brgyad bzlog pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags mo phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par las/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri bo'i byang phyogs/ nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs seng gdong phug nas/ rigs mthun gyi Dak+ki karma mu dra'i grogs bcas te spyan drangs shing / slar pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa bgyis//
